message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic chills and modern scares you might enjoy for a Friday‑night movie marathon:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological thriller with an iconic score and haunting imagery. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly shocking finale. |
| 3 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart social satire wrapped in a tense horror package. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspense built around silence—perfect for keeping everyone on edge. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head. |
| 6 | **It Follows** (2014) | An unsettling premise that keeps the tension high throughout. |
| 7 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted supernatural tale with plenty of jump‑scares. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that feels personal and deeply unsettling. |
| 9 | **Paranormal Activity** (2007) | Low‑budget found‑footage style that still delivers genuine fright. |
|10 | **The Ring** (2002) | A chilling remake that remains a staple of modern horror. |

Feel free to shuffle them or pick your favorites! Enjoy the frightful fun.
